name: 女道士
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept character redesign. Image1 is the user's approved unified STYLE AND COMPACT PROPORTION sample. Image2 is the previous identity/theme reference, NOT a costume to trace. Redesign the named subject into a distinctive new Chinese game character design using the direction below. Keep recognizable identity/theme, gender/age, palette and key props but intentionally refresh costume tailoring, silhouette rhythm, hair shape and personality-specific pose. Never clone the female blade sample's red outfit/face/hair across the cast. Match image1's bold controlled contours, coherent large gem-icon handpainted planes, 2-4 simple material shadows, graphic cartoon eyes with one small highlight max, no fragmented triangle mosaic, realistic eyes or 3D gloss. Humans approximately the SAME compact crown-to-sole head/body ratio as image1 (about four heads excluding hair/hats), retaining reasonable lean/stocky identity differences, no long-legged six-head fashion proportions. All women clearly adult, attractive natural full feminine curves and tailored garments but agile rather than heavy/barrel-thick; men retain distinct age/physique. Faces and bodies three-quarter facing SCREEN LEFT. Mild dynamic weight shift, two anatomically coherent separate legs and both feet readable, no parallel stiff pose or hidden extra leg. Props and hands structurally correct. Entire single full-body subject and ALL props safely inside a square canvas with 8% margins. Plain warm ivory #F4EFDF background, no shadows/scene/text/panels/extra people. Strong broad shape contrast, detail concentrated in only one or two zones. SPECIFIC DESIGN: 女道士：明确成年女性，平静聪慧、略带神秘笑意，半眯简洁凤眼，自然女性曲线、干练不过胖。黑色高道髻加木簪与小玉道冠、两条短宽蓝系带。靛蓝米白旧金朱砂小点缀，重新设计垂直长交领道袍、稍收腰、长短错落前后袍片，一侧宽垂袖另一侧束袖，蓝束裤布鞋。图形方向垂直线、修长矩形与一个大S形拂尘，保持与刀客近似紧凑头身比。腰一个太极圆章、袖边一块大云纹，不满身符文。前手举恰好两张分开的朱砂符纸仅少量图形笔画，另一手低持木柄拂尘一整束白尾，像中国道士而非西方魔法师。
